svg.title: Subhamita Adhikari — repository galaxy
svg.desc: An animated spiral galaxy where each named star is a GitHub repository: InsurEase (TypeScript), AI-Claims-Ace (TypeScript), employee_management (TypeScript), Arjun07707 (JavaScript). Star colour is the primary language, size is repository size, brightness is push recency, and distance from the core is age. Background dust is decorative.
svg.text: Beyond the Code. Into the Cosmos.
Each star is a repository. Dust is decorative.
